about.heroDescription: Pitonne is a concierge wellness service based in Nishi Azabu, Tokyo, offering premium IV therapy, stem cell related wellness support, and personalized care through in-home and hotel visits. We are designed for busy professionals, international visitors, and clients who value privacy, convenience, and clinically guided support. Our goal is to make wellness care feel more accessible, discreet, and tailored to real life in Tokyo.
about.whyWeExistContent: Our mission is to deliver discreet, high quality wellness support with clinical attentiveness, clear communication, and personalized care. We created Pitonne to offer a more thoughtful way to access IV therapy, stem cell related wellness support, and visit based services in Tokyo. By combining convenience with professional support, we aim to help each client feel cared for, respected, and supported in a way that fits their individual needs.
about.teamDescription: Our team brings together registered nurses, public health experience, and physician leadership to support each client with compassion and clarity.
about.visitBasedCareContent: Pitonne provides flexible visit based care for people who want wellness support that fits naturally into their schedule. Whether at home, in a hotel, or between demanding work commitments, our service is built to offer discreet and comfortable care in a setting that feels convenient and private. We support clients who value time, personalized attention, and a calmer care experience in Tokyo.
about.howWeSupportImageAlt: Pitonne visit-based care team arriving for private support
about.teamKanakoBio: Kanako is involved in the operation of a regenerative medicine clinic, with a focus on health optimization and preventive care. As a registered nurse and public health nurse, she supports treatments using stem cell conditioned media and provides wellness support including corporate programs, weight management, and fasting guidance. She believes in helping people care for their health before illness develops, while balancing preventive care with conventional medicine.
about.teamSaoriBio: Saori is involved in health support within the field of regenerative medicine, drawing on her knowledge and experience as a registered nurse and public health nurse. She values supporting each individual's daily well-being through treatment assistance using stem cell conditioned media, as well as preventive care, body maintenance, weight management, and corporate wellness programs.
about.teamAkiraBio: Since my years as a resident physician, I have practiced medicine with the words "Patient First" held close to my heart. Providing the kind of medical care that I would want to receive myself has always been the foundation of why I chose to become a physician. I believe that as long as I remain true to this principle, it will guide me in making the right decisions for my patients.

faqs.heroDescription: Find answers to common questions about mobile visits, in clinic appointments, service areas, appointment preparation, and Exosome IV therapy.

items.question: Are both mobile visits and in clinic appointments available?
items.answer: Yes. Pitonne primarily offers mobile visits to your home, hotel, or office, and in clinic appointments are also available. For in clinic appointments, a ¥5,000 discount applies to IV therapy services.

items.question: What areas do you serve for mobile visits?
items.answer: We are based in Nishi Azabu and primarily offer mobile visits across central Tokyo. Please review the service area details listed with each menu option. Depending on the request, appointments in farther areas may also be available upon consultation.

items.question: Is there an additional travel fee for mobile visits?
items.answer: Mobile visit fees are included within 5 km of our Nishi Azabu location. For appointments outside the 5 km service area, an additional travel fee applies based on distance. Please select the appropriate travel fee option when booking.

items.question: Is there a discount for in clinic appointments?
items.answer: Yes. For in clinic appointments, a ¥5,000 discount applies to IV therapy services. Please note that some services, such as blood testing, may be excluded.

items.question: Is an online medical consultation required before Exosome IV therapy?
items.answer: Yes. Exosome IV therapy is provided after an online medical consultation with a physician. Treatment is recommended based on your condition, goals, and medical suitability.

items.question: What purposes do clients typically choose Exosome IV therapy for?
items.answer: Exosome IV therapy is selected by some clients as part of their health management and conditioning routine. It is also chosen by those seeking additional support during demanding periods.

items.question: Can treatments be provided at hotels or offices?
items.answer: Yes. In addition to home visits, treatments can also be provided at hotels or offices. Please ensure that a quiet and comfortable space is available. Depending on the property, prior confirmation may be required.

items.question: What should I prepare before my appointment?
items.answer: No special preparation is required. Please prepare a comfortable space, such as a chair or sofa, where you can relax during treatment. Depending on your condition, some treatment details may be adjusted on the day of service.

items.question: Are your services available for international clients?
items.answer: Yes. English support is available. Our services are available for international travelers and guests staying in Tokyo, including mobile visits to hotels.

items.question: What if I'm not sure which service to choose?
items.answer: We can help guide you based on your concerns and goals. If you are unsure which service to choose, please contact us in advance or book an online consultation first.

items.question: Can I change or cancel my appointment?
items.answer:
If you need to change or cancel your appointment, please contact us as early as possible.

Cancellation fees apply starting 24 hours before your scheduled appointment time.

items.question: Are same day appointments available?
items.answer: Same day appointments may be available depending on schedule and location. Please contact us to confirm availability.
